history.name: Closing a release
history.description: When the product is actually presented, closing the release is the one moment the timeline moves: the work in progress gets the name of the moment it stands for and the date it happened, a fresh release opens behind it for whatever comes next, and everything marked as new or changed during the cycle goes quiet on its own. Nothing has to be un-tagged by hand, and the release just closed can be printed as an edition that will never change again.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/release.mjs — cut(). Reports what it covered and points at `ledger build` as the next step.
